get.summary: Edit a page together: a WebSocket carrying the page's shared draft, for somebody signed in who may edit the page.
get.description: Binary frames in y-protocols' framing: a varuint message type, then its payload. Sync (0) and awareness (1) are y-protocols' own; the server stores sync updates and passes them and awareness on without reading them. The server opens with room (100: the room's id as a string, its base version, and 1 when this client is to send its first content), then every stored update as a sync update and an empty sync step 2 when they are all sent; room starts every such load. A client sends updates as sync updates, seed (102: base version, update) when asked for first content, published (101: version) after publishing from the room, discard (103) to throw the room away for everybody, and compacted (105: from, to, count, merged update) when the server asks with compact (104: from, to, count) for the merge of the updates the last load carried. The server says base (107: version) when a publish moves the room on. Close codes: 4401 the session ended, 4403 the person may no longer edit, 4408 the client fell behind, 4409 the room was started afresh; load again for the last two.

101.description: Switching Protocols: the connection is a WebSocket from here on.

default.description: An error, in the one shape every endpoint uses.

parameters.name: X-Stator-Event
parameters.description: The topic, as in the body.

parameters.description: This attempt's id; a retry or a redelivery has its own.

parameters.description: The envelope version of the body, as in its version field.

parameters.name: X-Stator-Signature-256
parameters.description: sha256= and the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the body, keyed with the endpoint's secret.

parameters.name: X-Stator-Timestamp
parameters.description: When this attempt was sent, in Unix seconds.

parameters.name: X-Stator-Signature-Timestamped-256
parameters.description: sha256= and the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the timestamp, a dot and the body.

default.description: Not taken: the delivery is tried again later, with backoff, as is one not answered in time.

EnvelopeV1.description: What an endpoint registered for envelope version 1 is posted.

occurredAt.description: When the event happened, in UTC.

payload.description: The event's own fields, by topic, read as the endpoint's owner when the attempt is sent.

source.description: The product that sent the delivery, always stator. Added to version 1 without raising it, as a receiver ignores a field it does not know.

topic.description: What happened: ping, page.published, page.moved, page.deleted, comment.created, page.remote_link.removed. A receiver ignores a topic it does not know.

version.description: The envelope version, 1 here; the version header says the same.

token.description: A personal access token, made under Tokens in the account menu; a token with the read scope is refused every write, and one limited to spaces reaches nothing outside them and nothing that concerns the whole organization.
